column3: What About Kirino?
Did something happen to Kirino?
W-Well...
She's prejudiced towards Kirino's hobbies, so...
Can I honestly tell her about it?
Well, she hate lies...
Heck, why must I get frustrated over my sister's matters?
Ah, I think she was probably busy with special training for a game called Siscaly.
Sis-, caly?
That's right, there was a tournament yesterday, so that's why she underwent special training.
...So it's a game. In that case, I could understand, but...
Is there something else?
Well... She has been stuffing her ears with some song, humming and not listening to me at all!
That's probably...
She's likely listening and humming some recently aired anime's theme song.
Will Ayase believe me if I were to tell her frankly?
Am I... hindering her...?
No, that's... I wonder...
Eh? You're living with Kirino and you don't even know?
W-Well. We're not that close, you know...
Geez, it was a mistake to ask Onii-san about it!
N-Not good. I've messed up there.
I just want to talk with Kirino.... Am I a hindrance to her...?
You're not hindering her.
...Why can you say that so certainly?
...Kirino...
When Kirino quarreled with you in the past, have you forgotten how much effort she put in to reconcile with you?
Oh...
You don't have to worry, Kirino really likes you. About as much as you like her.
R-Really...?
Yes, absolutely. I can vouch for that.
R-Really... Ehehe... That's great then...
Ayase held both hands to her chest with her face turning red.
...What are you imagining?
Eh? A-Ah...!
A-Ahem. W-Well... Thank you very much, Onii-san.
Heh, don't mention it.
If it's for Ayase, this is nothing.
